name: Sol Kadhi
instructions: 1. Soak 5-6 kokum petals in half a cup of warm water for at least 30 minutes until the water turns deep pink.
2. In a blender, combine grated coconut, green chilies, garlic, and cumin seeds with a little water to make a smooth paste.
3. Extract the thick first milk by straining the mixture through a muslin cloth, then repeat with more water for thin milk.
4. Mix the kokum infusion into the coconut milk, adjusting the consistency as needed.
5. Season with rock salt and garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves.
description: Sol Kadhi is a signature beverage from the Konkan region of Maharashtra and Goa. It is traditionally consumed as an appetizer or a digestive aid after a spicy meal, prized for its cooling properties and distinct tangy flavor profile.
